summary: Integrate one planar four-bar generalized coordinate from applied torque while solving loop closure on a locked assembly branch.
objective: Build a bounded four-bar where torque, gravity and damping evolve the crank state and every accepted step satisfies joint closure without branch flips.
example_prompts: Apply a torque pulse to an open-branch four-bar and inspect crank speed, closure residual and energy.
negative_signals: Not prescribed crank animation, motor sizing, stress, bearing contact or a certified mechanism design.
not_for: No clearance, backlash, elasticity, impact, frictional joints or arbitrary spatial linkage.

entities.name: Links and pivots
entities.guidance: Blender authors rigid link shells and named pivot empties; numeric pivot-to-pivot lengths and mass properties are validated separately.

entities.name: Dynamics ledger
entities.guidance: Three.js or an attached numerical module solves branch-locked positions and integrates q/qdot from torque; show closure and energy residuals.

state_contract.model: Four rigid planar links with ground length L1 and moving lengths L2,L3,L4 have one generalized coordinate q=theta2 on a selected open or crossed assembly branch. For each q, solve circle-intersection/vector-loop closure for theta3,theta4 and reject no-assembly, branch-change and toggle/singular states where the closure derivative or derived M-prime is undefined. Declare viscous generalized damping d>=0. From declared link masses, planar inertias and centers of mass compute kinetic energy T=.5*M(q)*qdot^2 and potential V(q). Evolve M(q)*qddot+.5*M_prime(q)*qdot^2+d*qdot+dV/dq=tau(t), using fixed dt and a named root/integrator method. Kinematic mode may preview q but is a separate non-dynamic state and cannot generate a torque history.
state_contract.authority: The numerical controller owns q, qdot, branch, closure solve, mass properties, torque and history. Blender pivot empties define construction references after unit validation; mesh animation never becomes input motion.
actions: Select lengths and one assembly branch.
Apply a finite torque pulse or gravity and integrate one accepted step.
Preview a prescribed q only in labeled kinematic mode.
Reset to the exact assembled pose with zero velocity.

invariants: Every accepted pose closes both loop equations within authored length-scaled tolerance.
M(q)>0 and all mass/inertia inputs are finite and nonnegative, including d>=0.
A step cannot enter a toggle/singular configuration where closure derivatives or M-prime are undefined, or switch assembly branch silently.
With tau=0 and d>0, energy cannot grow beyond numerical residual tolerance.
motion_guidance: Play, pause and step advance the declared model clock only; reset restores parameters, state, solver budget, selections, errors and presentation transforms.
Use static before/after states and numeric tables for reduced motion; animation interpolates committed state and never supplies physical evidence.
creative_affordances: Blender may shape distinctive apparatus, cutaways and materials; Three.js binds named parts to authoritative state and keeps units and error states readable.
Camera, color, trails and deformation gain are presentation controls and cannot change the numerical model.
known_limits: One planar one-DOF rigid linkage away from toggle singularities; no claim of solver convergence, real mechanism clearance or fatigue life.
Authored, source-reviewed guidance only; no Blender export, numerical simulation, contact solve, browser or renderer was run.

claims.statement: A planar four-bar position is constrained by a closed vector loop; the moving joint is at the intersection of circles fixed by the two adjacent link lengths, giving open and crossed configurations when two intersections exist.
claims.scope: Planar revolute four-bar position closure only.

source_refs.locator: Position Analysis: graphical circle intersections and analytical closed vector loop

object_craft.structure: Build link shells around exact pivot empties and leave clearance around joints for inspection; add ghosted alternate-circle intersections only as diagnostics.
object_craft.material: Distinct patterns identify links and branch; torque and residual use labels rather than decorative motion blur.

physical_contract.scope: One generalized-coordinate planar rigid four-bar with torque, gravity and viscous damping.
physical_contract.timestep: Fixed dt; branch-locked closure solve followed by declared integration, rejecting failed closure or singular step.
colliders: none; revolute pivots are mathematical constraints
